sources.details: Counting: 2+1+1+1=5; final 6 is inconsistent. UTF-8: 14 three-byte non-ASCII characters plus 5 one-byte ASCII characters give 47, and replacement 5→6 is one byte. Universe 6^3=216; unordered repeated triples C(8,3)=56; seeded family split has 44/6/6 families. 900×24=21,600 sampled examples per branch. 466,322/48,803=9.555191279224637; 24−11=13. Recorded test sums divided once: 220.10995483398438/51=4.315881467333027 and 69.97113037109375/510=0.13719829484528187. For T>0 and z_i>z_j, odds exp((z_i−z_j)/T) increase as T decreases; entropy derivative Var_p(z)/T^3≥0; ties remain ties. Full derivations and execution details in a_notes/a_exec.
